data.narrative:
Muon Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $188M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse) and five public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-progression applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $188M raised proxy, implying a $357M valuation. Peer-median anchors to the five private comparables, which span $1.1B to $8.0B with a median of $1.5B. The public comp approach—which would use a 26.4x P/S median for the sector—is not applicable without disclosed revenue figures. These two methods triangulate to a range of $304M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $929M.

The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty in private space valuations at this stage. The stage-progression floor assumes minimal market premium, while the peer median is anchored by Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B and Sierra Space at $8.0B, both at or beyond Series B. Key unknowns include Muon Space's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and how recent market conditions have repriced similar-stage space assets relative to the comp set valuations.
